sidecar.predecessor_members: predecessor/<V1 identity>/<every V1 sidecar file, byte for byte>
sidecar.identity: sha256 of the canonical identity document {schema, population, contract_id, contract_sha256, predecessor_identity, shadow_identity, policy_frozen_utc, schedule_file, schedule_sha256, bundle}
sidecar.create_only: staged then renamed once; an existing identity is ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL or refused; nothing is overwritten, deleted or activated
sidecar.profile_gate: artifacts/data_lake/official_shadow_schedule_expansion_20261017_gate.json, committed after materialization, pins the actual successor profile

numeric_contract.integers: JSON integers only; a boolean or an integral float is not an integer; no binary float appears in schedule.json, the identity document or a served row
numeric_contract.identities: event, team, organization and request identities are JSON strings or integers exactly as frozen; an integer, float, boolean or string in another's place is a different value and is refused
numeric_contract.instants: UTC instants are strings YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ; local dates YYYY-MM-DD; local times HH:MM
numeric_contract.monotonic: journal monotonic stamps are integer nanoseconds (time.perf_counter_ns); spacing is their difference
numeric_contract.canonical_json: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) as UTF-8; schedule.json is these bytes plus one LF
numeric_contract.raw_bodies: raw/<sha256 of the exact body>.gz holds gzip.compress(body, mtime=0) of the exact received bytes
numeric_contract.policy_time: policy_frozen_utc is a string YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.ffffffZ frozen in the contract; rebuilds reuse it and never read the current clock

SIDEARM_NUXT_SCHEDULE.element: the single <script id="__NUXT_DATA__"> element: a devalue payload (every object member is an index into the payload array; Reactive/ShallowReactive/Ref/ShallowRef wrappers unwrapped)
SIDEARM_NUXT_SCHEDULE.season_record: each value of pinia.schedule.schedules whose own sport.shortname is 'football'

members.local_time: date (time part, only when tbd is false)

SIDEARM_TEXT_TABLE.element: the <table> inside the element with id scheduleTextPage
SIDEARM_TEXT_TABLE.season_binding: the first <h1> inside that element reads '2026 Football Schedule'
SIDEARM_TEXT_TABLE.owner_name: none (owner verified by another declared structure of the same document)
SIDEARM_TEXT_TABLE.records: each <tbody> row with exactly the header's seven cells

members.event_date: Date cell 'Mon D (Ddd)' (year: the season for March-December, the next year for January-February; the weekday must match)
members.location: Location cell before ' (', or the whole cell
members.facility: Location cell text inside a final '( ... )'

WMT_SCHEDULE_LIST.element: every <div> whose class tokens include schedule-event-item inside the element whose class tokens include schedule__view-box--list
WMT_SCHEDULE_LIST.season_binding: the <h1> whose class tokens include schedule-hero__title reads '2026 Football Schedule'
WMT_SCHEDULE_LIST.owner_name: each record's element with class token schedule-event-default__name--current

members.event_date: the datetime attribute of its <time> with class token schedule-event-date__day (local date part)
members.instant: the datetime attribute of its <time> with class token schedule-event-date__clock (explicit offset; not a statement when the date element has class token schedule-event-date--time-tba)
members.tba: class token schedule-event-date--time-tba on its schedule-event-date element
members.opponent: its schedule-event-default__name element without the --current token

SIDEARM_CLASSIC_SCHEDULE_DATA.element: the JSON object literal assigned to the member schedule (``schedule : {``) inside an inline <script> that registers the Vue component 'vue-schedules' (the classic SIDEARM schedule template); parsed strictly from its opening brace to its matching close
SIDEARM_CLASSIC_SCHEDULE_DATA.season_binding: the object's own season.title equals '2026' and its own sport.shortname equals 'football'

WMT_DEFAULT_EVENT_VIEW.element: every <div> with class token schedule-event-item and every <tr> with class token schedule-table-event that contains an element with class token schedule-default-event
WMT_DEFAULT_EVENT_VIEW.season_binding: the page's <h1> with class token schedule-hero__title or schedule-hero-block__title reads a declared season heading (SEASON_HEADINGS)
WMT_DEFAULT_EVENT_VIEW.owner_name: none: the record's owner side is its schedule-default-event__team--current element, which states no name (the owner is verified only by a page-identity decision)

members.event_date: the texts of its <time> schedule-event-date__weekday ('Ddd') and schedule-event-date__month-day ('Mon D'); year by the season-year rule; the weekday must match
members.opponent: its schedule-default-event__name text without its schedule-default-event__divider-mobile and schedule-default-event__ranking descendants
members.designation: AWAY only when its schedule-default-event__divider reads 'at'; 'vs.' does not distinguish HOME from NEUTRAL and states no designation
members.location: its schedule-event-location text before a final '( ... )'
members.time_text: its schedule-event-item-result__label text only when it reads as a time or TBA

WMT_TEAM_DEFAULT_VIEW.element: every <div> with class token schedule-event-item and every <tr> with class token schedule-table-item that contains a schedule-event-team-default element and no schedule-event-default__name--current element
WMT_TEAM_DEFAULT_VIEW.season_binding: the page's <h1> with class token schedule-hero__title or schedule-hero-block__title reads a declared season heading (SEASON_HEADINGS)
WMT_TEAM_DEFAULT_VIEW.owner_name: none: logo-only team components (the owner is verified only by a page-identity decision)

members.event_date: the text of the <time> inside its schedule-event-date__time ('Ddd, Mon D'); year by the season-year rule; the weekday must match
members.time_text: its schedule-event-item-result__label text only when it reads as a time or TBA

WMT_EVENT_BLOCK_VIEW.element: every <div> with class token schedule-event-block and every <tr> with class token schedule-item-table

members.event_date: the datetime attribute of its <time> schedule-event-date__day (local date part only; its clock is a placeholder for TBA events and states no time)
members.designation: class token schedule-event-date--venue-home/away/neutral on its schedule-event-date element
members.time_text: its schedule-event-item-result__label text only when it reads as a time or TBA

2026-27 Football Schedule.rule: a 2026-27 label denotes football season 2026 (its first calendar year) and binds only records with a complete own date (month, day and matching weekday) resolved by the season-year rule

Football 2026 Schedule Schedule.rule: the retained heading text exactly as published (a repeated word); names football season 2026

season_year_rule: a month-day text without a year takes the season year for March-December and the next year for January-February; the stated weekday must equal that date's weekday, otherwise no date
text_rule: character references decoded, every whitespace run one space, stripped

name_rules.normalization: text rule, then a leading poll rank '(#N)', '#N', '#N/M' or 'No. N' removed, then casefold
name_rules.owner: a document's every own-team name statement binds the frozen provider home team (displayName, shortDisplayName or location) or the NCAA official name of the selected institution; one binding and no non-binding statement verifies the owner
name_rules.opponent: a record's own opponent equals the frozen provider away team's displayName, shortDisplayName or location; abbreviations, mascots, numeric identifiers, substrings and fuzzy matches never bind
name_rules.opponent_annotation: in the opponent field only, after the leading poll rank: a final separately delimited ' (<annotation>)' whose text is exactly a known event annotation (KNOWN_EVENT_ANNOTATIONS) is removed, and only when the remaining exact name binds the event's own provider opponent; unknown parentheticals are never removed; the original string and every transformation are kept with the witness

identity_members.og:site_name: the content of every <meta property="og:site_name"> element of the page

decision_kinds.OWNER_STATEMENT: the document's own-team name statements that the V1 rule does not bind are each exactly one of the decision's owner statements, and every identity member of the decision is present in the same document with exactly its decided value (every occurrence equal)
decision_kinds.PAGE_IDENTITY: the document's declared records state no owner name, and every identity member of the decision is present in the same document with exactly its decided value (every occurrence equal)

decision_bases.OFFICIAL_LEADING_CLAUSE: value == the NCAA official name's text before its first ','
decision_bases.OFFICIAL_NAME_WITHOUT_FINAL_WORD: value == the NCAA official name without its final word
decision_bases.OFFICIAL_LEADING_CLAUSE_WITHOUT_FIRST_WO: value == that leading clause without its first word
decision_bases.PROVIDER_DISPLAY_NAME: value == the frozen provider owner displayName
decision_bases.PROVIDER_LOCATION_PLUS_ATHLETICS: value == the frozen provider owner location + ' Athletics'
decision_bases.PROVIDER_LOCATION_OFFICIAL_WEBSITE_TITLE: value ends with 'The Official Website of ' + the frozen provider owner location + ' Athletics'
decision_bases.PROVIDER_TEAM_NAME: value == the frozen provider owner name (team nickname)
decision_bases.DIRECTORY_ATHLETICS_HOST_BRAND: value without spaces, casefolded, is contained in the NCAA directory athletics host of the institution, and its first word equals the frozen provider owner location

owner_rules.provider_or_official_name: the V1 rule: every own-team name statement binds the frozen provider home names or the NCAA official name (OWNER_VERIFIED)
owner_rules.documented_identity: an OWNER_STATEMENT decision for the event's own NCAA institution holds in the same document (OWNER_VERIFIED_DOCUMENTED_IDENTITY)
owner_rules.page_identity: a PAGE_IDENTITY decision for the event's own NCAA institution holds in a document whose declared records state no owner name (OWNER_VERIFIED_PAGE_IDENTITY)
owner_rules.scope: a decision applies only to its own NCAA organization id; every basis is checked against the frozen official name, provider names and directory host at derivation; identity members establish who owns the schedule and never supply an opponent, date, role, venue or time

field_rules.event_binding: a record of a declared structure in a document with a verified owner and a 2026 season binding is bound to the event when its own opponent binds the frozen away team and its own local date is in the provider date set (the calendar dates of the provider instant at offsets -04:00 to -10:00)
field_rules.occurrences: records of the bound opponent on other dates, records on the event date naming an unbound opponent and records whose date cannot be determined are retained as occurrences, never as witnesses
field_rules.field_state: SUPPORTED when every bound witness stating the field states the same value, CONFLICTING when they differ (all values kept, never a majority vote), UNSUPPORTED when none states it
field_rules.opponent: SUPPORTED by a bound record; CONFLICTING when a bound record and a record naming an unbound opponent share the event date; with no bound record an unbound opponent name on the event date stays UNSUPPORTED (an unbindable name may be another team or the same team; never fuzzy-resolved)
field_rules.event_date: the bound witnesses' local dates; with no bound record, the bound opponent's other dates are CONFLICTING with the provider date
field_rules.designation: HOME/AWAY/NEUTRAL from the record's own designation member; the provider claim for the owner is NEUTRAL when its neutralSite is true, otherwise HOME
field_rules.venue: facility and location text from the record's own members; the facility is compared with the provider venue name (AGREES when equal after the text rule and casefold, otherwise TEXT_DIFFERS)
field_rules.season: SUPPORTED when the bound record's structure binds football season 2026 by its own season member
field_rules.opponent_binding: a record's own opponent binds when its normalized name (NAME_RULES) equals the frozen provider away displayName, shortDisplayName or location
field_rules.designation_views: WMT default-event views state AWAY only by an 'at' divider ('vs.' states nothing); team-default views by their venue-type text; event-block views by their venue class token
field_rules.json_ld: embedded JSON-LD is never a field source; its SportsEvent role orientation is censused per document, and a JSON-LD event on the event date (its startDate's own date part when naive, otherwise the calendar dates of its explicit instant at offsets -04:00 to -10:00, intersecting the provider date set) naming the bound opponent on the side opposite the bound designation leaves the designation CONFLICTING with both values

time_rules.explicit: an ISO-8601 local date-time with an explicit offset or Z in the record's own instant member
time_rules.stated_zone: a time text whose final token is a US zone designator: generic ET/CT/PT resolved by the US daylight rule (second Sunday of March 02:00 to first Sunday of November 02:00 local) on the record's own local date; EDT/EST/CDT/CST/PDT/PST/MDT must agree with that rule's state; MST is a fixed -07:00; generic MT is ambiguous; a local time in a transition gap or fold is ambiguous
time_rules.naive: a time without offset or designator stays NAIVE_LOCAL_TIME (no zone is inferred from the campus or site)
time_rules.tba: TBA/TBD text, a Nuxt tbd flag or a WMT time-tba token is TBA; the placeholder clock is not a statement
time_rules.resolution: SUPPORTED_INSTANT when all instant statements agree and every naive local time and the instants' own local times agree; TBA when every statement is TBA; NAIVE_LOCAL_TIME_ONLY when only equal naive times exist; AMBIGUOUS_TIMEZONE when only ambiguous designators exist; CONFLICTING otherwise
time_rules.authority: a supported instant is OFFICIAL_SCHEDULE_CLAIM, never ACTUAL_KICKOFF
time_rules.result_label: a WMT result label is a time statement only when it reads as a clock time (optionally with a zone designator) or TBA; any other text (a past result) is not a statement and is never retained
time_rules.event_block_clock: the clock part of an event-block view's day datetime is not a time statement (a placeholder for TBA events)

availability_rule: the effective availability is the later of the retained capture's observation bound (the maximum response end UTC of every attempt, re-derived by the accepted BAT-726 reader) and this contract's policy_frozen_utc; before the observation bound the sidecar is refused SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE_BEFORE_OBSERVATION_BOUND, before the policy-frozen time SCHEDULE_UNAVAILABLE_BEFORE_POLICY_FROZEN; at or after both the same immutable evidence is served
